title: Criminalization of Homelessness
question_text: How should government address people sleeping or camping in public spaces?

stances.text: Protecting the right to sleep and shelter in public spaces, with no penalties of any kind
Decriminalizing public sleeping and camping in public spaces
Allowing enforcement only when adequate shelter beds are available, with citations diverting people to services rather than the criminal justice system
Prohibiting encampments on public property, enforced through graduated warnings and civil penalties
Banning public camping and sleeping with criminal penalties to maintain public safety and order
